term.label: anti_ARRET

definition.text: A non-coding RNA transcript, derived from the transcription of the telomere. These transcripts are antisense of ARRET transcripts.

comments: Telomeric transcription has been documented in mammals, birds, fish, plants and yeast. Requested by Antonia Lock, October 2012.
